# glossary

The handbook's glossary as folio-glossary/v1 SKOS schemes: the consolidated dth-hrh scheme, the TWG candidate definitions and the professional-council examples, built from the TWG workbook by scripts/glossary/build_glossary.py. Its page is core's per-instance glossary page, written into this site with --instance dth-hrh.

Part of [Digital Transformation Handbook: Planning for Human Resources for Health and Health Worker Registries](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `glossary`, holding `glossary`.
